ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multilingual patient intake and triage engine designed for rural Indian clinics to prioritize emergency cases and streamline doctor workflows.
ideas.title: ArogyaSync AI Patient Triage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly hits the HealthTech Innovation theme requested by the organizers, solving an acute local pain point familiar to the judges.

ideas.pitch: Localized AI nutrition and wellness assistant that tailors meal plans using traditional Indian dietary ingredients and regional health profiles.
ideas.title: AyurNutri Personal Dietitian
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact winning formula of past wellness hackathon winners by combining hyper-localized nutritional insights with a polished user interface.

ideas.pitch: A transparent pharmaceutical supply chain tracker ensuring counterfeit medicine detection using lightweight cryptographic logging for local pharmacies.
ideas.title: MedChain Audit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides genuinely hard engineering and clear measurable social impact within the healthcare sector.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered community coordination platform that connects elderly residents in urban neighborhoods with verified student volunteers for medical errands.

ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven social-good formula of matching vulnerable populations with local volunteers, appealing heavily to community organizers.

ideas.pitch: A real-time emergency department wait-time forecasting and load-balancing dashboard utilizing Poisson regression models to optimize patient routing.
ideas.title: HospitalQ Predictor
